description: .NET MAUI packaged Windows apps can still prompt for .NET or fail on clean machines unless both .NET self-contained publishing and Windows App SDK self-contained deployment are configured, based on https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/19763.
prompt: I need to ship my .NET MAUI Windows build to customers who don't have developer tools installed. The MSIX installs, but on a clean Windows 10 VM the app prompts for the .NET 8 runtime, and another attempt crashed with `REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG` after I tried random publish flags.
